display_rank_transform.definition: Within each event, retain the existing 18 display channels, exclude nonparticipants, preserve their original order and rank them 1..n_participating. Nonparticipants remain NaN.
display_rank_transform.ridge_definition: Exact discrete conditional rank frequencies; each channel is divided by its own maximum only for ridge height. No smoothing. Peak heights are not comparable across channels.

A.closeup_geometry: channel-level schematic at measured bipolar-pair midpoints; rounded A1 end at lower left; silver external connector cap at upper right with continuous curved lead
A.amplitude_scale: single common gain for all Y1 channels and excerpts; spacing=8*SD of all displayed samples, same rule as the original waveform producer

external_lead.reference_scope: electrode-to-cable connection only; cap geometry is schematic

magnification_contact_correspondence.rule: ellipse boundary beside deepest physical contact

A.claim_boundary: one symbol per bipolar channel at its measured pair midpoint, not a one-contact monopolar claim; node widths, external connector cap and cable path are schematic

B.method: full original event S**3 weighted centroid
B.normalization: per-channel/event maximum for display; S**3 for centroid

C.profile_band: mean +/- population SD of participating-event ranks

E.profile_band: mean +/- population SD of participating-event ranks

paired_distribution_inset.display: paired subject points and lines, mean bars, and paired Wilcoxon bracket

spectrogram.edge_policy: extend first/last spectrogram cells to snippet bounds; no x-axis white strips

panel_b.method: full original event S**3 weighted centroid
panel_b.normalization: per-channel/event maximum for display; S**3 for centroid

changed_panels: C legend markers and rank heading
